channel.title: Sorana releases
channel.description: Release notes for Sorana, the free desktop AI knowledge workspace and agent harness for Windows and Linux.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.102
item.description: Projects board reliability: cards stay responsive to mouse, grid density slider takes effect, right-click menus no longer log false errors, and tab switches preserve saved board settings.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.101
item.description: Research answers stay on topic, pasted links are left alone, boards keep their size when switching, project cards use the width you give them, and quality reviews are never silently skipped.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.100
item.description: New Projects board: a second canvas where every project gets its own assistant, folder, and notes. Both boards keep their own view, zoom, grid density, and positions.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.99
item.description: Web research reports what it actually found, reuses results it already paid for, handles moved pages honestly, and still answers when a turn passes its token cap.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.98
item.description: Grid density now resizes the workspace, each workspace remembers its own density, large boards open and pan faster, and health cards keep their order.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.97
item.description: Guided agent creation, smoother streaming for long answers, faster large workspaces, and clearer model-fallback notices.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.96
item.description: Background work shows live progress, prompt management moves to a central two-pane workspace with draft generation, sessions renew automatically, and the calendar works offline from cache.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.95
item.description: Per-agent daily token budgets with a guided wizard, auto-closing chat sidebar option, tougher memory capture, and cleaner status wording.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.94
item.description: Tool progress visible in chat, responsive health-dashboard grid, more reliable memory capture, and accurate research citations.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.93
item.description: Memory understands life domains, cycle input history instantly, sessions stay alive with auto token refresh, faster retries with prompt-prefix caching, and sturdier web research.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.92
item.description: MCP tools slash command, research answer quality (fetched sources outrank pasted text), enriched research trace, live-suite hardening, reviewer cost control, background job tracking, approval-gated memory distillation, agent output caps, graceful search degradation, and fixes for URL probing, memory bleed, sidebar orphans, telemetry leaks, approval-resume crashes, and Gmail archive progress.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.91
item.description: 13 selectable themes with picker, whole-app theme sweep, central color palette, IT/NL/PL language parity, natural wording in 7 languages, agent card upgrades, persistent Model Manager layout, resizable sidebars, enforced max reply length, background token refresh, responsive trace flow layout, and theme/markdown/memory fixes.

item.title: Sorana 1.0.90
item.description: Redesigned Agent Advanced tab, agent card upgrades, persistent Model Manager layout, supervised subagent runtime, token refresh, multi-angle coverage proof, reviewer judge-independence, grounding telemetry, and synthesis/parser fixes.
